deterministic_exhaustive_basket_countere.assumption_for_transition_fixture: one losing leg is reported closed first; all remaining still-tradable legs are unwound at unchanged entry bids before exit fee/slippage

interpretation: This does not claim the current resting Graph/RV basket has filled or encountered asynchronous resolution. It is a deterministic source-level settlement defect: a fully matched structural payoff can be converted into a taker unwind solely because closed/resolution metadata arrives leg by leg.
required_successor_contract: separate SETTLING from ABORTING for structurally matched units
preserve matched structural units when only a subset of legs reports closed
use an authoritative event-level terminal barrier or require every matched leg to have terminal outcome before final settlement
unwind only residual unmatched exposure when closure metadata is partial
separate operational fill completion, economic hedge completion and terminal settlement in the ledger
do not treat a post-end hold deadline as an executable-book exit path for terminal structural baskets
